claim: Tropical maps run a weather group every 2 to 6 days: Rain (two days, the Cooling meter refills at twice its fall rate) or a Heat wave (two days, the Cooling meter falls four times as fast), each announced two days ahead.

evidence.reference: LevelEventGroupBehaviour "Tropical Events" (MinPeriodInDays 2, MaxPeriodInDays 6) with LevelEventBehaviour "Rain" (Refreshment multiplier −2, 2 days) and "Heat wave" (Refreshment multiplier 4, 2 days).

notes: Which levels attach the group is set per map; the Tropical biome page lists it.
